```{r}

#############################################################################################################

# Replication asymmetry analysis of hPu-hPy motifs using OK-seq data
# - Identifies the 100 most abundant hPu-hPy motifs from Simple Repeat annotations
# - Selects repeat motifs with unit lengths ≤ 8 nucleotides
# - Imports replication fork directionality (RFD) profiles from multiple OK-seq datasets
# - Classifies repeat occurrences according to positive and negative replication fork orientation
# - Quantifies motif occurrences within rightward- and leftward-replicating domains
# - Computes replication asymmetry ratios as POS/NEG for each motif family
# - Calculates asymmetry scores using |log2(POS/NEG)|
# - Aggregates individual motifs into biologically related repeat-family groups
# - Identifies hPu/hPy-forming repeat families and compares them with other repeat classes
# - Computes mean replication asymmetry scores for each repeat-family group
# - Generates labeled asymmetry scatterplots highlighting hPu-hPy-associated families
# - Performs non-parametric statistical analyses:
#     - Kruskal-Wallis test across repeat-family groups
#     - Pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction
#     - hPu-hPy versus Other repeat-family comparisons
# - Creates formatted statistical summary tables
# - Exports graphical outputs and statistical results as figures and Excel files
#
# Requirements:
#   - dplyr
#   - ggplot2
#   - tidyr
#   - ggrepel
#   - forcats
#   - rstatix
#   - data.table
#   - openxlsx
#   - GenomicRanges
#   - IRanges
#   - rtracklayer

#############################################################################################################

# Packages installation CRAN + BIOCONDUCTOR
cran_pkgs <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "tidyr",
  "ggrepel",
  "forcats",
  "rstatix",
  "data.table",
  "openxlsx"
)

bioc_pkgs <- c(
  "GenomicRanges",
  "rtracklayer"
)

# Utility function: install only missing CRAN packages
install_missing_cran <- function(pkgs) {
  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    install.packages(
      missing,
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }
}

# Utility function: install only missing Bioconductor packages
install_missing_bioc <- function(pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(
      "BiocManager",
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }

  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    BiocManager::install(
      missing,
      ask = FALSE,
      update = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# Install missing packages
install_missing_cran(cran_pkgs)
install_missing_bioc(bioc_pkgs)

message("All required packages are installed.")

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(forcats)
library(rstatix)
library(data.table)
library(openxlsx)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)

#############################################################################################################

# Create the top100 8nt motif file
# Read input file
df <- read.table("/simpleRepeathg19/bed/file/path",sep = "\t",header = FALSE,stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

retirer_motifs_sym <- function(df, col = "V17") {
  motifs_sym <- c("AT", "TA", "CG", "GC")
  df[!(df[[col]] %in% motifs_sym), ]
}

df <- df[!grepl("^[AT]+$", df$V17) &
         !grepl("^[CG]+$", df$V17), ]

df <- retirer_motifs_sym(df)

top100_df <- df %>%
  count(V17, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)

# Top 100 motifs
top100_motifs <- df %>%
  count(V17, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>%
  pull(V17)

# Keep all the motif lines corresponding to Top100
top100_df <- df %>%
  filter(V17 %in% top100_motifs) %>%
  select(V2, V3, V4, V17)

# Top 100 motifs the most frequent
top100_df <- df %>%
  count(V17, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)

# Keep only the motifs with a length < or = to 8
top100_8nt <- top100_df %>%
  filter(nchar(V17) <= 8)

motifs_8nt <- top100_8nt$V17

coord_8nt <- df %>%
  filter(V17 %in% motifs_8nt) %>%
  select(V2, V3, V4, V17)

# Save the file
write.table(coord_8nt, "/ouput/file/path",sep = "\t",quote = FALSE,row.names = FALSE)

#############################################################################################################

# Import coord_8nt bed file
rep <- fread("/coord_8nt/bed/file/path",header = FALSE)
colnames(rep)[1:4] <- c("chr","start","end","motif")

gr_rep <- GRanges(
  seqnames = rep$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(rep$start + 1, rep$end),
  motif = rep$motif
)

# RFD OKseq files
rfd_files <- c(
  cellline1 = "/rfd/file/path/cellline1",
  cellline2 = "/rfd/file/path/cellline2",
  cellline3 = "/rfd/file/path/cellline3",
  cellline4 = "/rfd/file/path/cellline4"
)


# Ratio computation
compute_ratio <- function(file, cellline){
  rfd <- fread(file, header = FALSE)

  colnames(rfd)[1:4] <- c("chr","start","end","RFD")

  gr_right <- GRanges(
    seqnames = rfd$chr[rfd$RFD > 0],
    ranges = IRanges(
      rfd$start[rfd$RFD > 0] + 1,
      rfd$end[rfd$RFD > 0]
    )
  )

  gr_left <- GRanges(
    seqnames = rfd$chr[rfd$RFD < 0],
    ranges = IRanges(
      rfd$start[rfd$RFD < 0] + 1,
      rfd$end[rfd$RFD < 0]
    )
  )

  res <- lapply(unique(rep$motif), function(m){
    gr_motif <- gr_rep[mcols(gr_rep)$motif == m]
    n_right <- length(unique(
      queryHits(findOverlaps(gr_motif, gr_right))))
    n_left <- length(unique(
      queryHits(findOverlaps(gr_motif, gr_left))))

    data.frame(
      CellLine = cellline,
      motif = m,
      Right = n_right,
      Left = n_left
    )
  })

  bind_rows(res)
}

all_res <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(rfd_files),
    function(cl) compute_ratio(rfd_files[cl], cl)
  )
)

family_groups <- list(
  "AG GA CT TC" = c("AG","GA","CT","TC"),
  "AAG AGA GAA / CTT TCT TTC" = c("AAG","AGA","GAA", "CTT","TCT","TTC"),
  "AAAG AAGA AGAA GAAA / CTTT TCTT TTCT TTTC" = c("AAAG","AAGA","AGAA","GAAA", "CTTT","TCTT","TTCT","TTTC","TTTCT","TTTCTT"),
  "AAGG AGGA GAAG GGAA / CCTT CTTC TCCT TTCC" = c("AAGG","AGGA","GAAG","GGAA", "CCTT","CTTC","TCCT","TTCC"),
  "AGGG GAGG GGAG / CCTC CTCC TTCC" = c("AGGG","GAGG","GGAG", "CCTC","CTCC","TTCC"),
  "AAAAG/TTTTC" = c("AAAAG", "TTTTC", "CTTTT"),
  "AAAAAG/TTTTTC" = c("AAAAAG", "TTTTTC","TTTTCT"),
  "AAAAAAG" = c("AAAAAAG"),
  "AAAAAAAG" = c("AAAAAAAG"),
  "GATA/TAGA" = c("GATA","TAGA","TATC","CTAT", "ATAG","GATG","CATC","TATG", "ATAC","TCTA", "AGAT","ATCT"),
  "TCCA/TCCC/ATCC/CCAT" = c("TCCA","TCCC","ATCC","CCAT","TGAA","TGGA"),
  "AC/TG" = c("AC","CA", "TG", "GT"),
  "AAC/TTG" = c("AAC","TTG","TGT"),
  "AAAC/TTTG" = c("CAAA","TTGT","TTTG","GTTT","TGTT"),
  "AAAAC/TTTTG" = c("AAACA","CAAAA","AAAAC", "TTGTT","TTTGT","GTTTT","TTTTG","TGTTT"),
  "AAAAAC/TTTTTG" = c("AAAACA","CAAAAA", "TTTTGT","TTTTTG"),
  "AAAAAAC/TTTTTTG" = c("AAAACAA", "AAAAACA", "TTTTTTG"),
  "ATGG" = "ATGG",
   "GAGAGG" =  "GAGAGG"
)

hpu_hpy_families <- c(
  "AAG AGA GAA / CTT TCT TTC",
  "AAAG AAGA AGAA GAAA / CTTT TCTT TTCT TTTC",
  "AAGG AGGA GAAG GGAA / CCTT CTTC TCCT TTCC",
   "AGGG GAGG GGAG / CCTC CTCC TTCC"
)


get_family_group <- function(motif) {
  for(nm in names(family_groups)) {
    if(motif %in% family_groups[[nm]]) {
      return(nm)
    }
  }
  return(NA)
}

# Family labels
family_labels <- c(
  "AG GA CT TC" = "(GA/TC)n",
  "AAG AGA GAA / CTT TCT TTC" = "(GAA/TTC)n",
  "AAAG AAGA AGAA GAAA / CTTT TCTT TTCT TTTC" = "(GAAA/TTTC)n",
  "AAGG AGGA GAAG GGAA / CCTT CTTC TCCT TTCC" = "(GGAA/TTCC)n",
  "AGGG GAGG GGAG / CCTC CTCC TTCC" = "(GGGA/TCCC)n",
  "AAAAG/TTTTC" = "(GAAAA/TTTTC)n",
  "AAAAAG/TTTTTC" = "(GAAAAA/TTTTTC)n",
  "AAAAAAG" = "(GAAAAAA/TTTTTTC)n",
  "AAAAAAAG" = "(GAAAAAAA/TTTTTTTC)n",
  "GATA/TAGA" = "(GATA/TATC)n",
  "TCCA/TCCC/ATCC/CCAT" = "(TCCA/TGGA)n",
  "AC/TG" = "(CA/TG)n",
  "AAC/TTG" = "(CAA/TTG)n",
  "AAAC/TTTG" = "(CAAA/TTTG)n",
  "AAAAC/TTTTG" = "(CAAAA/TTTTG)n",
  "AAAAAC/TTTTTG" = "(CAAAAA/TTTTTG)n",
  "AAAAAAC/TTTTTTG" = "(CAAAAAA/TTTTTTC)n",
  "ATGG" = "(ATGG/TACC)n",
   "GAGAGG" =  "(GAGAGG/CCTCTC)n"
)


# Family attibutions
all_res$FamilyGroup <- sapply(
  all_res$motif,
  get_family_group
)

all_res <- all_res %>%
  filter(!is.na(FamilyGroup))

# 
universe_ratio <- all_res %>%
  group_by(
    FamilyGroup,
    motif
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    POS = sum(Right),
    NEG = sum(Left),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Ratio = (POS + 1)/(NEG + 1),
    Module = abs(log2(Ratio))
  )

# Mean score by family group
family_score <- universe_ratio %>%
  group_by(FamilyGroup) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanModule = mean(Module, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Classe = ifelse(
      FamilyGroup %in% hpu_hpy_families,
      "hpu_hpy",
      "Other"
    ),
    Label = family_labels[FamilyGroup]
  )

# Plot
p <- ggplot(family_score,aes(x = "",y = MeanModule,colour = Classe)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(size = Classe),width = 0.15,height = 0) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Label),colour = "black",size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(hpu_hpy = "red",Other = "grey40")) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(hpu_hpy = 4,Other = 2.5)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = NULL,y = "Mean|log2(Ratio)|") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),legend.position = "none")

print(p)

#############################################################################################################

# Statistics
# Calculation of mean Module by motif
motif_stats <- universe_ratio %>%
  mutate(
    Classe = ifelse(
      FamilyGroup %in% hpu_hpy_families,
      "hpu_hpy",
      "Other"
    )
  )

# Kruskal global test
kruskal_result <- kruskal.test(
  Module ~ FamilyGroup,
  data = motif_stats
)

# Pairwise comparison between families
pairwise_results <- motif_stats %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Module ~ FamilyGroup,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  )

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    Family_1 = family_labels[group1],
    Family_2 = family_labels[group2]
  )


# hPu/hPy versus other groups
wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(
  Module ~ Classe,
  data = motif_stats,
  exact = FALSE
)

# Statistic table creation
# Table of pairwise comparison between families
table_pairwise <- pairwise_results %>%
  select(
    Family_1,
    Family_2,
    P_value = p,
    P_adjusted_BH = p.adj,
    Significance = p.adj.signif
  ) %>%
  arrange(P_adjusted_BH) %>%
  mutate(
    P_value_format = ifelse(
      P_value < 0.001,
      "< 0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", P_value)
    ),
    P_adjusted_format = ifelse(
      P_adjusted_BH < 0.001,
      "< 0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", P_adjusted_BH)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Family_1,
    Family_2,
    P_value,
    P_adjusted_BH
  )


# Table hpu_hpy vs Other
table_hpu_hpy <- data.frame(
  Comparison = "hpu_hpy vs Other",
  P_value = wilcox_result$p.value
) %>%
  mutate(
    P_value_format = ifelse(
      P_value < 0.001,
      "< 0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", P_value)
    ),
    Significance = case_when(
      P_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

# Table of Kruskal-Wallis test
table_kruskal <- data.frame(
  Test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  P_value = kruskal_result$p.value
) %>%
  mutate(
    P_value_format = ifelse(
      P_value < 0.001,
      "< 0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", P_value)
      ),
    Significance = case_when(
      P_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

# Creation of excel file
wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "Comparaisons_family")
addWorksheet(wb, "hpu_hpy_vs_Other")
addWorksheet(wb, "Kruskal_Wallis")

writeData(wb, "Comparaisons_family", table_pairwise)
writeData(wb, "hpu_hpy_vs_Other", table_hpu_hpy)
writeData(wb, "Kruskal_Wallis", table_kruskal)

header_style <- createStyle(
  fontColour = "white",
  fgFill = "black",
  textDecoration = "bold",
  halign = "center",
  border = "Bottom"
)

for(sheet in sheets(wb)) {
  n_cols <- ncol(read.xlsx(wb, sheet))
  addStyle(
    wb,
    sheet,
    header_style,
    rows = 1,
    cols = 1:n_cols,
    gridExpand = TRUE
  )

  freezePane(wb, sheet, firstRow = TRUE)

  addFilter(
    wb,
    sheet,
    rows = 1,
    cols = 1:n_cols
  )

  setColWidths(
    wb,
    sheet,
    cols = 1:n_cols,
    widths = "auto"
  )
}

# Save the files
output_file <- "/statistical/results/excel/output/path"

saveWorkbook(wb,output_file,overwrite = TRUE)

cat("Excel saved:", output_file)

ggsave("/asymetry/plot/output/path",plot = p,width = 3,height = 6)

#############################################################################################################

```
